book.name: AROGAMENI
book.title: AROGAMENI Iesu Keriso Dion arogameni noa

content: Garao mumeni wagewa

Amba bet ine inana gapan yawana kiman gapan waenapan aruga iragen anega waiwanumune, “Kaewa kaewa, God yaua ao warat, God inap gaun baware. Me wat inakam nimaniniwa menan yaua ao warinain, aro amun mega wande aiwandan.

Me tamana tavewa gapan wanene tainiwa. Pa sewa Babilon, ame waen negin gagape iniwa wainan gogo amba koewa ugup ugup taiwandini mini menan waenapan wat anamon menan God nemoro me inap tan. Waen ame God nave taine nagirewa guramon borit wane menan wanene ta garewa wanen.”
Amba anega sia uma den wane, “Kaiwa, kaiwa, God yaua ao warat! God inap gaun baware. Pa baware igiren merao mega usenagaet dot iwandata.”

Waenapan kwayup tamuine apane daiton apan da naniwa degede (24) kasiga mena manao taini da bayabayapa den God watat mega gagap wandiniwa inap omanimup enun anega wa taragasen, “Ame umap. God yaua ao warat! God inap gaun baware.”
Man Sip Otua barip megawa
Amba den, God watat mega gapan nop da taueni anega anun, “God nuga wa atonatait. Me viripe den nao mega taine nagirewa yauya bawarewa go mondigawa iragi God me wa atonasen.”
Ap anega wani, waenapan arugataet tapan arugawa ununkewa mini amba ait waini ununkewa umap ne anega anun, “God ao warat, God inap gaun baware. God aro amun aigap iragenawa apanewa, nu ayop nugawa di!
Nu aton anut potanu tarep warep yaua ao warat. Iwa Man Sip Otua Iesu naisepi wamewa tauen, waen mega ben waren wandia.
God wani gapan waen wanup mega kakae iragena, pomponu wat enen.” Wanup kakae iragena pepeku wani ame God waenapan mega mu tat muga kakaewa ame.
Amba anea inanap anega wan, “Nop ma ok se. Man Sip Otua naimopi baripewa munan wan onamopi nagirewa aton anuin.” Wani aigap sia anega wan, “Nop ame tavewa God megawa.”

Ap anega wani, ne wa taragasepen menan namup omaninap enuna go me anega wadianegen, “Ae ve, ap ya ta! Nu gende Iesu noa warine nagire amba anu tumasine nagirewa den. Nu iravi Iesu wat arogameni noa anu tumasivin menan God megenat wa taragat ne ya wa taragat nimanege.” Anea, ne manega dienegen. Iesu wat arogameni noa aroewa gapan God no oise waine nagirewa nop ugup ugup waenapan wadidiamuiwanum.
Apan man osi pomponu gagap tauen
Amba kiman watapen man osi pomponu ne yawan. Apan man gagap wandeni yaua Ayamat ge Nop Tavewa Apanewa. Koewa kakaewa wanene tamana om warini gapan ita anan taiwan.
Yamewa merao umap doren amba ayop payu mega iape aruga. Yaua da wapip karaua sen, go yaua ame, me megenat anuiwan.
Wanup umaseni denip enu batamen, me yaua diane God Nop Megawa.
Ita anan kimaniwa nagirewa me evip amon wanup muga gwambenben pomponu wat enane osi muga pomponu ame gagap amon.

Kereba wani den me no nokap tau aen. Kereba ap gapan waenapan at at guramuiwandata. Kepata nanip ware waenapan kaimakaet namup yoniwandata. Apan da taba gureip tavewa magosen kaum wain viseni umap osi gagap taueni apanewa God aroe amunu dena apanewa ugu gangan mega baware koewa da waenapan muneta.
Wanup mega gagap amba agua gapan me yaua ok anega sen. Yaua ame, Baware Nagire Bawarewa mugawa Ayop Nagire Ayop mugawa, ok sen.
Amba anea da wam gagap yoneni yawan. Nenip man tap ugup ugup nainewa kimani yaumakap tau amuiwanumune inamup nop uma wan, “Onaen, mapa God barip mega gapan iamen,

Waenapan etua nan. Ayop nagirewa ita yamewa nagirewa amunu dena nagirewa osi gagap amuinewa osi muga den apan ugup ugup yaumu bawarewa mondigawa muk taine ago taine nagire iravi etumua nan.” Anea nenip ap anega diamon.
Kwarayo amba piup ayopewa, mu ita nagirewa den iam iam tauan apan osi gapan wandeni apanewa ita mega nagire den anan inamup tapen tauane, ne yawan.

Tauane gapan kwarayo ton waran. God nop mega tave uoni waiwandin yo paua ugup ugup taiwandini apanewa ame den waran. Apan ame waenapan kwarayo yatup mega paua wapimup batamen kwarayo guewa nanimup kaitane inap wa taragasene nagirewa paua ame taiwandini gapan aopan ewamon. Menan kwarayo amba God nop mega tave uoni waiwandini apane dere tambun kaum awan merave dena dagin yananagaet aninke den gwanap aipa uatamen.
Apan osi gagap wandini apanewa kereba no nokap tau aeni gapan anavi mega ita nagirewa guramon borit wan. Man tap naine nenipewa tauan etumua nane bagumu bim bam wan.
